verses.text: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
lines: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven,
whose sin is covered.

verses.text: Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
lines: Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn’t impute iniquity,
in whose spirit there is no deceit.

verses.text: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
lines: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

verses.text: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer.
lines: For day and night your hand was heavy on me.
My strength was sapped in the heat of summer.

verses.text: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin.
lines: I acknowledged my sin to you.
I didn’t hide my iniquity.
I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh,
and you forgave the iniquity of my sin.

verses.text: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.
lines: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found.
Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

verses.text: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance.
lines: You are my hiding place.
You will preserve me from trouble.
You will surround me with songs of deliverance.

verses.text: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
lines: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go.
I will counsel you with my eye on you.

verses.text: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.
lines: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding,
who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.

verses.text: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.
lines: Many sorrows come to the wicked,
but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.

verses.text: Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
lines: Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous!
Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
